correctness.rationale: Homogeneous gradient product forces residue characteristics 3 or 11; direct torus coordinates exclude singular points lying on the cubic in characteristic 3. In characteristic 11 the entire gradient scheme is F11[s]/((s-4)^11), by five-equation elimination; the Hessian has rank 3. Projective line projection proves rationality and two independent finite enumerations give 1464 rational points.
